_doc: PREBEN HOLM dating cabinet (#30, Wave D, built 2026-07-17-eve; roster #36). The Danish-freehand prodigy (1947-1989): first pipes sold June 5, 1963 (11 days before his 16th birthday); factory CLOSED EARLY 1986 = the hard ceiling (a brief same-year re-entry attempt failed on health). SOURCES: staging/pipedia/Preben_Holm.json (INCLUDES his own 1983-84 autobiography = primary) + Winslow.json (Andersson 1997). ⚠️ CROSS-CABINET CORRECTION NOTED: benwade.json carries 'Handmade Denmark' Preben Holm window 1971-89 (to his death); the autobiography says staff dismissed END 1985 + factory closed EARLY 1986 -> Danish Ben Wade production realistically ceased 1986; benwade bracket kept wide (death ceiling) with this note mirrored there.

history_anchors._doc: b. June 16, 1947. Age 15: cellar workshop (1/2 m²) in father's Copenhagen provision shop; JUNE 5, 1963 first pipes sold (father's shop, then Pipe-Dan, 20-30/week). Grain-following freehands invented at ~500kr vs 30kr standard — the 'Danish Design' fancy wave. 'PIPE LON' pipes for Lon Schwartz (St. Thomas, US Virgin Islands; US monopoly; c.1965 examples known). March 1969: Snug Harbour (NYC) US cooperation + series production; bought out a pipe factory; 45 employees at age 22. Snug Harbour defaults -> FEBRUARY 1971 meeting with Herman G. Lane -> Ben Wade label (Lane-owned name; finishes altered; qualities upgraded); later Lane sold 'Preben Holm' pipes too (Snug Harbour's leftover stock became instant collectors' items). 12-13 year Lane cooperation. 1983 (autobiography year = 20th anniversary): staff of 20; DIAMOND COLLECTION launched 'this year' (50,000kr pieces, golden ring + diamond); PRIVATE COLLECTION = his signature grade (~2% of production, personally molded + finished + SIGNED). Head-assistant Poul Winslow (hired 1967). END 1985: most staff dismissed (US market collapse); EARLY 1986: factory closed completely; re-entry attempt 1986 stopped by illness; died 1989 (42). Lines outside the Lane contract: RUNGSTED (Mariner, Viking), MONTE VERDI; also Caprice/Britta Beck label pipes; 'Ben Wade Nobel Prize 2000' = precursor of the Private Collection (undated).

brand_marks.physical: Fancy freehands: grain-chased shapes, smooth+blast combos, bark-top crowns, bark stem-ends. Grades incl. Private Collection (e.g. '404C') with his signature. Series-produced era pipes (1969-71) exist alongside handmades. Ben Wade-labelled Danish production = see benwade.json (its own cabinet).

line_years._notes: pipe lon: the Lon Schwartz US-monopoly brand — from the early sales (c.1963-65 examples) until the Lane switch (1971); approx edges. diamond collection: launched 'this year' in the 1983 autobiography -> [1983,1986] to the closure. NOT encoded: private collection (intro undated; 'Nobel Prize 2000' precursor), rungsted + monte verdi (undated side lines), Britta Beck / Caprice (label pipes, undated).
